rules: Custom top areas must use wx.getMenuButtonBoundingClientRect and place content below capsule bottom.
Primary cards inside .pad must fill the content width.
No CTA or information card may shrink to text-content width.
All clickable visual containers use view + bindtap during the visual baseline phase; native button layout is disallowed.
Horizontal metric cards may scroll, but each card keeps a stable width.
Native tab bar content must reserve at least 78px plus safe-area bottom.
All secondary pages must leave enough top space for the WeChat capsule when using custom nav.
